provenance: Evidence in docs/external_eval/dataset_audit.md (FireMan sections). Tier verified_2023 = thermal partner video shows the on-screen date 2023-08-26; such a video cannot overlap Boreal (all Boreal burns are from 2022: Evo 2022-05-24, Heinola 2022-06-28, Karkkila 2022-07-06, Ruokolahti 2022-08-15). All other videos are 'unverified' because FireMan lists two 2022 dates (2022-07-06, 2022-08-16) that coincide within one day with Boreal's Karkkila and Ruokolahti burns, and no per-video date is published.
scene_clusters: hash <= 6 bits AND thumbnail correlation >= 0.9 with >= 3 cross-video frame pairs (local_data/external_eval/fireman/work/scene_groups.json); clusters are ids of connected components, C01.. in order of first video name
